title: Does rutent permit VOS's AGPL-3.0-or-later licence?
lead: Adopting VOS needs your licence decision recorded in licences/RECORD, case by case, with no counsel step (DEC-6).
bullets: 11 VOS crates are AGPL-3.0-or-later and 14 are Apache-2.0, per EXP-1-vos-20261107-1.
221 other packages need lines too; permissive ones stand permitted, copyleft ones come to you.
Needed only if VOS was chosen on exp1-adopt-runtime.
No VOS code reaches main until this decision is recorded.
options: Permit it for VOS's AGPL-3.0-or-later crates
Decline it; VOS stays not adopted
